results.title: Dolly Parton, a legend of country music, dies at the age of 80.
results.description: The singer, composer and actress died peacefully on Tuesday in Nashville, her family said.

results.title: Ripken Stadium Investment: Youth Sports Plan
results.description: The Ripken Stadium investment approved in Maryland’s 2026 budget cycle gave Aberdeen a clear sports-facility question: can a $5 million state grant help a baseball venue and its surrounding youth fields generate stronger local returns without losing sight of community sport? The available public record supports the main outline of the project, but it does not provide a full return-on-investment model. That makes a cautious reading necessary. Maryland’s Fiscal Year ...
